data.name: Omer
data.gender_notes: Omer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Omer is an Arabic name that means 'long life' or 'flourishing'. It is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name Omer carries the meaning “Long life” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Omer usually hope their child will grow to embody long life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Omer is considered a blessed name in Islamic tradition, symbolizing a long and prosperous life.
data.etymology: Omer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Long life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Omer total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عمر
in_arabic.long_meaning: عمر هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي (عمر) الذي يعني الحياة الطويلة والعيش الطيب. وهو أحد الأسماء التي أطلقت على سيدنا عمر بن الخطاب، ثاني الخلفاء الراشدين في الإسلام، والذي عرف بشجاعته وحكمته. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بطول العمر والصحة الجيدة.

in_urdu.name: عمر
in_urdu.meaning: عمر کا مطلب ہے لمبی عمر اور خوشحال زندگی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عمر ایک عربی نام ہے جو (عمر) جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے لمبی عمر اور خوشحال زندگی۔ یہ نام حضرت عمر بن خطاب کے نام سے مشہور ہے، جو اسلام کے دوسرے خلیفہ راشد تھے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ایک ایسے شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو لمبی عمر اور خوشحالی کی خصوصیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: उमर
in_hindi.meaning: उमर का अर्थ है लंबी उम्र और सुखी जीवन
in_hindi.long_meaning: उमर एक अरबी नाम है जो अरबी जड़ (عمر) से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है लंबी उम्र और सुखी जीवन। यह नाम हज़रत उमर इब्न अल-खत्ताब के नाम से प्रसिद्ध है, जो इस्लाम के दूसरे खलीफा थे। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो लंबी उम्र और सुखी जीवन का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: عمر
in_pashto.meaning: عمر معنی یې د اوږد عمر او خوشحالۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: عمر د عربي نوم دی چی د (عمر) جذر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې د اوږد عمر او خوشحالۍ. دا نوم د حضرت عمر بن خطاب په نامه مشهور دی، چی د اسلام دوهم خلیفه راشد وو. په افغان او پښتون قومونو کې، دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چی د اوږد عمر او خوشحالۍ ځانګړی وي.

in_english.name: Omer
in_english.meaning: Omer means long life, prosperity and happiness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Omer is derived from the Arabic root (عمر), which signifies long life, prosperity, and happiness. It is famously associated with Umar ibn Al-Khattab, the second Caliph of Islam, known for his justice and leadership. In Islamic tradition, Omer symbolizes a person who leads a long, healthy, and successful life, embodying virtues of courage, wisdom, and spiritual growth. The name Omer is widely used across Muslim cultures, reflecting its historical and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Omer has a rich cultural history as it is associated with one of the most revered figures in Islamic history, Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab (574-644 AD). He was an influential leader who significantly contributed to the development of the Islamic empire through his military campaigns and political acumen. In modern times, Omer is a common name in the Islamic world, and it is also used as a surname among Muslim communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Omar carries the hope of long life and prosperity, fulfilling its literal meaning. In Islamic tradition, the name is also associated with the virtues and character traits of the second caliph, Umar ibn Al-Khattab. He was a just ruler, a brave warrior, and an exemplary leader who set high standards for Muslims to emulate. Therefore, parents may choose the name for their child, hoping that they may grow up to embody the values of spiritual and moral excellence that Umar represented.

historical_references.reference: Omar ibn al-Khattab (583-644 AD) was the second caliph of Islam and the first caliph of the Rashidun Caliphate.
historical_references.context: Omar was a military commander and a key figure in the early Islamic conquests. He was known for his justice and fairness, and his rule saw the expansion of the Islamic empire beyond the Arabian Peninsula.
